newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy's Snia BPD and Snia Fibre shares suspended.
newsitem.headline: Italy's Snia BPD and Snia Fibre shares suspended.

text.p: Shares in Italian chemicals group Snia Fibre and its controlling group Snia BPD were suspended for today on the Milan bourse awaiting a statement, Italy's stock market watchdog Consob said.
Both groups are controlled by industrial group Fiat, which announced in January a plan to merge Snia Fibre into Snia BPD. In January, Snia BPD owned some 83.68 percent of the capital of Snia Fibre.

The statement in January said the merger process would be examined by both group's boards in March when they approved their results for 1996. It added Ernst and Young would assist in assessing the swap ratio for the operation on the basis of economic and equity criteria and on stock market values.
